Scene 1. Jonah turns the machine shop into the heart of the colony. He explains to a new technician that a workshop on Mars is like a second circulatory system; if you cannot fix things, every other system starts bleeding out.

Scene 2. Tomas assigns robots to assist with assembly.

Scene 3. Mei objects when greenhouse labor is cut again.

Scene 4. The crew works through the night in a mood halfway between invention and desperation.
